disclosure.$description: Tokens for Disclosure: a button that shows or hides a group (the Search group in AcmeCo's menu; later accordions, audit F25). Measured from AcmeCo's menu (live site, 2026-10-10). Decision 36.

padding-x.$description: PROPOSED: 8px, so the hover fill doesn't touch the text.

gap.$description: PROPOSED: 8px between the label and the chevron.

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 500 for the menu's group headings over 300 for their links; with two weights (decision 4), 600 over 400.

background-hover.$description: PROPOSED: a grey fill on hover (not observed).

chevron-size.$description: OBSERVED: a chevron at the row's end that points up when open (AcmeCo's Search button); 16px.

padding-start.$description: OBSERVED: the group's links line up with the button's text (corrected 2026-10-10 from a reference screenshot: the 10px measured earlier was the links' own box offset, not a visible indent); the lighter weight sets them apart.
